description: LE-20: element-wise operands whose shapes cannot be broadcast raise a located, catchable shape error instead of reading out of bounds. `(* (vector 1 2 3) (vector 4 5))` answered `#(4 10 4.4e-323)` with exit 0 — the Scheme-vector kernel looped to operand 1's length over operand 2's element array — and the tensor spelling of the same pair crashed, because the runtime's -1 'not broadcastable' verdict was discarded and the uninitialised result rank was read back. `run_stderr_forbidden` pins both failure modes shut, and `MUST-NOT-PRINT` pins that nothing after the failing form runs.

runtime_diagnostics.contains: Shape mismatch in tensor-mul: shapes (3) and (2) are not broadcast-compatible
